description.html: Enter and Exit the Tub Safely Lightly textured large surface bench Reversible back and armrest Non-slip suction cups on interior feet Tool-Free Assembly 400 Pound Weight Capacity Lifetime Guarantee View Details > Prodcut Description Getting in and out of the tub can be a risky moment for seniors, post-surgery patients, and individuals with limited mobility. The Vive Tub Transfer Bench addresses that directly by letting you sit down outside the tub and slide across into the bathing area, keeping your weight supported throughout the entire transfer. It gives seniors, post-surgery patients and those with limited mobility a way to bathe safely without needing assistance. The lightweight aluminum frame is corrosion-resistant and holds up to 400 pounds through daily wet use. Suction cup feet lock onto the tub floor from inside while non-slip rubber caps keep the outer legs grounded on the bathroom floor, keeping the bench firm on both sides. The textured seat drains water through built-in holes and the reversible back with height-adjustable legs from 18.5" to 23.5" lets it fit almost any standard tub. It arrives semi-assembled with setup taking around 10 minutes. For additional wet floor protection around the bench, our Shower & Bath Mats are a practical add-on. Backed by Vive Health's warranty, this shower transfer bench is built for seniors, caregivers and anyone who needs a dependable long-term bathing solution at home. Browse our full Transfer Aids collection gives you everything needed for safer, more independent daily transfers. Features REDUCE THE RISK OF INJURY Promotes bathroom safety and independence supporting 400 pounds SIMPLE ASSEMBLY AND INSTALLATION Arrives semi-assembled for quick and easy placement in your bathroom ADJUST TO FIT The reversible seat back and adjustable leg height will accommodate almost any tub NON-SKID FEET Feel safe as you wash with strong suction cup feet and nonslip rubber caps CLEANSE IN COMFORT A textured seat with built-in drainage provides a stress-free bath DURABLE ALUMINUM FRAME The lightweight yet durable frame is corrosion-resistant and easily cleaned with any bathroom cleaner Customer Reviews Based on 23 reviews Write a review What are the dimensions of the transfer bench? The transfer bench is 30.5” wide at the base and 22” deep. What are the dimensions of the seat? The seat is 26.25” long and 16” wide. How wide is the seat back? The seat back is 16.5”. How wide is the arm rest? The seat back is 11”. How tall are the transfer bench legs? The transfer bench legs are height adjustable in ½ inch increments, from 18.5” to 23.5”. Will this transfer bench fit over a high-sided tub? The transfer bench by Vive can clear up to 21" Is the transfer bench seat back reversible? Yes, the seat back can be used on either side of the transfer bench. Is the transfer bench seat back removable? Yes, the back is removable by pressing the two release buttons under the bench and sliding it out. How do I assemble my Vive Tub Transfer Bench? Is the transfer bench armrest reversible? Yes, the armrest can be used on either end of the transfer bench. Are the transfer bench legs removable? Yes, the legs are removable. How long will it take to assemble the transfer bench? The assembly should take about 10 minutes. Will I need tools to assemble the transfer bench? A Philip's head screw driver is needed to assemble your transfer bench. Why are there holes in the transfer bench seat? The holes conveniently drain water away so that you are not sitting in a puddle. Does the transfer bench stick outside of the tub? Yes, to use the transfer bench safely, the suction cupped legs should be in the tub and the rubber tipped legs should be outside of the tub. Will a shower curtain fit around the transfer bench? Most shower curtains will not fit around the bench and stay in the tub. For best results, use a handheld showerhead to control water spray. Can I remove one of the seat sections? No, the seat sections are not removable. How much weight will the transfer bench hold? The transfer bench will accommodate up to 400 pounds. How much does the transfer bench weigh? The shipping weight is 14.4 pounds. Uses: Transfer to and from wheelchair and tub safely and securely Bathe in comfort while seated Dimensions: 30.5 inches wide 22 inches deep The legs and seat adjust up to 23.5 inches high Materials: Lightweight and corrosion-resistant aluminum Cleaning Instructions: Wipe down with wet cloth and disinfectant Air dry What’s Included: Transfer Bench Lifetime warranty UPC: 818323020014 Product Number: LVA1041 Shipping Weight: 14.4 pounds User Manual: Transfer Bench by Vive
